# Breakaway — Full Reference

- Name: Breakaway
- Type: Professional services technology firm (AI agents, process automation, systems integration)
- Website: https://breakaway.work

- Address: Paseo del Cantil 125, Real de Juriquilla, C.P. 76226, Querétaro, México

## What Breakaway Does

Breakaway integrates the tools professional firms already use — CRM, ERP, spreadsheets, email, WhatsApp, and billing — and automates repetitive operational workflows with AI agents and event-driven automations. The focus is process-first delivery: diagnose one workflow, ship a working solution in 4–6 weeks, then expand.

Core capabilities:
- Multi-agent AI orchestration connected to real business data (CRM, email, billing)
- Workflow automations with triggers, business rules, and monitoring
- Bidirectional integrations across CRM, ERP, WhatsApp, email, and billing systems
- Custom web pages, portals, and applications when workflows need dedicated interfaces
- Process consulting: mapping, automation prioritization, and phased roadmaps
- Hands-on team training for new tools and agents

Breakaway does NOT offer generic chatbots or platform migrations. Integrations are built around existing stacks.

## Services (canonical URLs)

### AI Agents
- ES: https://breakaway.work/es/services/ai-agents
- EN: https://breakaway.work/en/services/ai-agents
AI agents that read context from CRM, email, and billing; execute tasks across systems; and maintain auditable logs. Designed for professional services workflows, not generic chat.

### Process Automations
- ES: https://breakaway.work/es/services/automations
- EN: https://breakaway.work/en/services/automations
Event-driven automations that eliminate copy-paste, manual follow-ups, and repetitive checks. Includes error handling, retries, and alerting.

### Integrations
- ES: https://breakaway.work/es/services/integrations
- EN: https://breakaway.work/en/services/integrations
Connect CRM, ERP, spreadsheets, email, WhatsApp, and billing. Bidirectional sync, webhooks, API connectors, and WhatsApp-to-CRM routing.

### Web Pages
- ES: https://breakaway.work/es/services/web-pages
- EN: https://breakaway.work/en/services/web-pages
Landing pages, client portals, and internal tools connected to CRM and automations — forms that trigger real workflows.

### Apps
- ES: https://breakaway.work/es/services/apps
- EN: https://breakaway.work/en/services/apps
Custom web and mobile applications (including PWAs) integrated with existing data and operational stack.

### Consulting
- ES: https://breakaway.work/es/services/consulting
- EN: https://breakaway.work/en/services/consulting
Process mapping, automation prioritization, and actionable roadmaps — typically delivered in 2–3 weeks.

### Training

- EN: https://breakaway.work/en/services/training
Live workshops, role-based documentation, and post-launch support windows for teams adopting new agents and automations.
